verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stripe Treasury has an API reference page (docs.stripe.com/api/treasury/financial_accounts) and LLM-friendly docs (llms.txt, markdown pages). Nothing shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. A static reference and machine-readable docs are adjacent features and do not count as an interactive, runnable API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
